WorkAlarm.title: WorkAlarm
WorkAlarm.description: Represents a scheduled work reminder or bioscience laboratory protocol alarm owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

title.description: Short title of the work alarm or bioscience step (1-120 chars).

notes.description: Detailed task checklist, reagent concentrations, or work context (0-500 chars).

enabled.description: Whether the alarm is currently active.

daysOfWeek.description: List of recurring weekday numbers (1=Mon .. 7=Sun), empty for one-shot.

bioTempCelsius.description: Target temperature or lab condition note (e.g., '37.0°C / 5% CO2'), empty if standard work.

protocolDurationMin.description: Duration of the associated focus or lab protocol timer in minutes (0-1440).

vibrate.description: Whether haptic vibration is enabled when the alarm triggers.

completedCount.description: Number of times this work session or protocol has been completed.

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/work_alarms/{alarmId}.description: Root collection of user-scoped work alarms and bioscience protocol reminders.
